definitions.explanation: The ability to understand spoken language, or the act of doing so. Used mainly in language education and proficiency testing contexts.

examples.japanese: {聴解|ちょうかい}の{試験|しけん}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm bad at listening comprehension exams.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}ポッドキャストを{聞|き}いて{聴解|ちょうかい}{力|りょく}を{上|あ}げている。
examples.english: I listen to podcasts every day to improve my listening comprehension.

examples.japanese: JLPTの{聴解|ちょうかい}セクションでは、{会話|かいわ}やアナウンスを{聞|き}いて{答|こた}える。
examples.english: In the JLPT listening section, you listen to conversations and announcements and answer questions.

notes:
USAGE:
{聴解|ちょうかい} is used almost exclusively in educational and testing contexts. It is one of the standard skill categories in language proficiency tests such as the JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聴解|ちょうかい}{力|りょく} (listening comprehension ability)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}{問題|もんだい} (listening comprehension questions)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}{練習|れんしゅう} (listening comprehension practice)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}セクション (listening section)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Paired with {読解|どっかい} (reading comprehension) in language testing. While {読解|どっかい} covers written text, {聴解|ちょうかい} covers spoken audio.
